title: fix(sse): correct partial-JSON delimiter ordering and token/event framing in SSE stream
author: Maya Patel
description: Fixes ordering bug in SSE stream framing that caused partial JSON chunks to be emitted with delimiter tokens and token/event boundaries out of order, leading to consumers observing malformed partial JSON objects and intermittent parse failures. Root cause: a race between the chunking code in core/sse/streamer.go and the token event serialization when partial_json mode is enabled; a refactor in a previous change changed when delimiter tokens were flushed relative to token finalization. This PR reorders delimiter emission to always emit delimiter tokens after token/event finalization, consolidates chunk assembly into a single code path to avoid double-flush, and adds a small sequence-number header for token events in debug builds to help detect ordering regressions in the wild. The change set includes unit tests for multi-token partial JSON streaming, an integration test exercising the openai compatibility layer with client reconnects, updates to the docs to explain partial JSON guarantees, and a perf canary configuration used to validate throughput and latency impact. Checklist: - add regression unit tests - add integration test for reconnects - run full CI and perf canary - update docs (docs/sse.md) - include release notes. See commits for details and incremental rationale.

release_notes: Fix SSE streaming bug causing malformed partial JSON when delimiter tokens were emitted out-of-order. Improves stability for streaming clients and fixes reconnect/partial-object parse failures. Backported to release/2026-02 for customers running partial_json mode.
